workplace_task.fil: Sa loob ng 2–4 linggo, ipasuri ang isang mungkahing pagpapabuti sa supervisor gamit ang job aid.
workplace_task.en: Within 2–4 weeks, review one improvement proposal with the supervisor using the job aid.

supervision.fil: Gamitin ang parehong indicator; obserbahan, magbigay ng feedback at umulit.
supervision.en: Use the same indicator; observe, give feedback and retry.

delivery: content specification only; no reminders scheduled

check.prompt_fil: Sa saradong silid, maaaring malanghap ang particles mula sa umuubo. Ano ang angkop?
check.prompt_en: In an enclosed room, particles from a cough may be inhaled. What is appropriate?

options.fil: Sabihing sapat na ang pagpunas sa mesa para sa lahat ng panganib.
options.en: Say wiping the desk alone addresses every risk.

options.fil: Pangalanan agad ang sakit at ipaalam sa buong pila.
options.en: Immediately name the illness and tell the entire queue.

options.fil: Sundin ang proseso ng BHS para sa respiratory controls.
options.en: Follow the BHS process for respiratory controls.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Hindi nito natutugunan ang posibleng paglanghap. 2: Hula ito at hindi angkop na pagbabahagi ng impormasyon. 3: Sa posibleng paglanghap, sundin ang napagkasunduang ayos ng lugar, pag-uulat at proteksiyon ng BHS.
check.feedback_en: 1: This does not address possible inhalation. 2: This guesses a diagnosis and discloses information inappropriately. 3: Possible inhalation calls for the BHS's agreed arrangements for space, reporting and protection.

check.prompt_fil: May concern sa bentilasyon. Ano ang tamang susunod na hakbang?
check.prompt_en: There is a ventilation concern. What is the appropriate next step?

options.fil: Ilipat agad ang lahat sa silid na hindi pa nasusuri.
options.en: Immediately move everyone to a room that has not been assessed.

options.fil: Ipaalam at ipasuri sa responsable.
options.en: Report it and have the responsible person review it.

options.fil: Sabihing ligtas ang silid kahit walang anumang pagsusuri.
options.en: Declare the room safe without any assessment.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Maaaring hindi angkop ang bagong lugar. 2: May tamang pagsusuri at pag-aayos ng facility. 3: Walang sapat na batayan ang katiyakan.
check.feedback_en: 1: The new location may be unsuitable. 2: This enables appropriate facility review and action. 3: The reassurance lacks a basis.

check.prompt_fil: Natatapos ang handrub pero basa pa. Ano ang gagawin?
check.prompt_en: Handrub has been applied but hands are still wet. What next?

options.fil: Kuskusin hanggang matuyo.
options.en: Continue rubbing until dry.

options.fil: Punasan agad sa suot na damit para makabalik sa gawain.
options.en: Wipe it on clothing immediately to return to work.

options.fil: Banlawan sa tubig kahit wala pang buong handrub procedure.
options.en: Rinse with water before completing the handrub procedure.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Hayaang matuyo habang kinukumpleto ang handrub sa lahat ng bahagi. 2: Hindi dapat punasan ang handrub at maaaring makontamina muli. 3: Hindi bahagi ng handrub ang pagbanlaw nito.
check.feedback_en: 1: Let hands dry while completing rubbing across all surfaces. 2: Handrub should not be wiped off; hands may be recontaminated. 3: Rinsing is not part of the handrub procedure.

check.prompt_fil: Naitapon na ang tissue, pero nahawakan ang secretions. Ano ang kasunod?
check.prompt_en: The tissue has been discarded, but the person touched secretions. What next?

options.fil: Humawak agad sa ibang tao dahil wala na ang tissue.
options.en: Immediately touch someone else because the tissue is gone.

options.fil: Itago ang ginamit na tissue para ipasa sa susunod.
options.en: Keep the used tissue to give to the next person.

options.fil: Linisin ang kamay bago humawak ng iba.
options.en: Clean hands before touching anything else.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Maaaring may kontaminasyon pa sa kamay. 2: Hindi dapat ibahagi o gamitin muli ang ginamit na tissue. 3: Bahagi ng kumpletong sequence ang hand hygiene.
check.feedback_en: 1: Hands may still be contaminated. 2: Used tissues should not be shared or reused. 3: Hand hygiene is part of the complete sequence.

check.prompt_fil: Hilaw na manok ang katabi ng lutong pagkain. Ano ang pagbabago?
check.prompt_en: Raw chicken is beside cooked food. What should change?

options.fil: Hayaan lamang basta takpan nang sabay sa iisang lalagyan.
options.en: Leave them together under one cover in the same container.

options.fil: Ihiwalay ang hilaw sa luto.
options.en: Separate raw and cooked food.

options.fil: Tikman ang luto upang malaman kung may mikrobyo.
options.en: Taste the cooked food to determine whether germs are present.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Hindi pinipigilan ng iisang takip ang kontaminasyon sa pagitan nila. 2: Nababawasan ang paglipat mula sa hilaw na pagkain. 3: Hindi ligtas o maaasahang pagsusuri ang pagtikim.
check.feedback_en: 1: One cover does not prevent contamination between them. 2: This reduces transfer from raw food. 3: Tasting is neither a safe nor reliable test.

check.prompt_fil: Magkaiba ang lumang poster at bagong instruction. Ano ang gagawin?
check.prompt_en: An old poster conflicts with a newer instruction. What should happen?

options.fil: Kumpirmahin sa IPC contact.
options.en: Confirm with the IPC contact.

options.fil: Piliin ang mas madaling sundin kahit hindi pa malinaw.
options.en: Choose whichever is easier despite the uncertainty.

options.fil: Markahang kumpleto ang checklist upang hindi na magtanong.
options.en: Mark the checklist complete to avoid asking.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Nililinaw ang kasalukuyang naaangkop na gabay. 2: Maaaring hindi angkop o ligtas ang napiling instruction. 3: Itinatago nito ang tunay na kakulangan.
check.feedback_en: 1: This clarifies the applicable guidance. 2: The selected instruction may be inappropriate or unsafe. 3: This conceals the actual gap.

check.prompt_fil: Hindi pa na-refill ang sabon sa follow-up. Ano ang dapat itala?
check.prompt_en: Soap has not been refilled at follow-up. What should be recorded?

options.fil: Tapos na ang gawain dahil may nangakong magre-refill.
options.en: The task is complete because someone promised a refill.

options.fil: Walang problema dahil may naunang training ang lahat.
options.en: There is no problem because everyone received training.

options.fil: Itala na hindi pa naayos at muling ipaalam.
options.en: Record it as unresolved and report it again.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Pangako ay hindi ebidensiya ng resulta. 2: Hindi pinapalitan ng training ang kailangang supply. 3: Tapat ang tala at may susunod na aksyon.
check.feedback_en: 1: A promise is not evidence of completion. 2: Training does not replace the needed supply. 3: The record is accurate and prompts further action.
